references.text: Sered, Elon and Jahleel are mentioned as the sons of Zebulun in Genesis, forming the basis for the clans listed here in the census.
The first census of the tribe of Zebulun in the wilderness, showing the size of the tribe at the beginning of the journey through the desert.
The following verse gives the total number of the tribe of Zebulun in this second census.
The tribal inheritance of Zebulun in the promised land, showing the fulfillment of the promises to this tribe and its clans.
